title: Surface semantic fallback and hybrid provider metadata in default API responses
description: Current non-envelope semantic/hybrid APIs can obscure whether ONNX embeddings actually ran or whether token fallback was used. Add a compatibility-safe response metadata path so clients can see provider mode, fallback reason, and hybrid fusion context without having to opt into alternate formats.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from deep-audit findings about silent semantic fallback and hybrid metadata ambiguity. Any implementation should preserve backward compatibility while making provider mode/fallback explicit for diagnostics and automation.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Moved to InProgress during non-model follow-up. Current pass prioritized code-search retrieval reliability and benchmark harness hardening; API response metadata surfacing remains the next high-ROI item from this audit group.
